bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
systemctl --user stop gace-userbot-verify.service
trap 'systemctl --user start gace-userbot-verify.service || true' EXIT
cd "$root"
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from telethon import TelegramClient
from scripts.userbot_session import load_credentials,SESSION_BASE
EXPECTED=[["相手募集","募集+Room","告知/予告"],["プロフ作成","クリエーター有料ビデオ投稿"],["🔗ボタン作成","検索/フィルター"],["雑談","紹介/招待","操作説明"]]
async def main():
    api_id, api_hash=load_credentials()
    async with TelegramClient(str(SESSION_BASE),api_id,api_hash) as c:
        assert await c.is_user_authorized(),"USERBOT_AUTH_REQUIRED"
        target=await c.get_entity("GayBBS_bot")
        msgs=await c.get_messages(target,limit=12)
        choices=[m for m in msgs if not m.out and m.buttons]
        assert choices,"BOT_DM_MENU_MISSING"
        latest=choices[0]
        rows=[[b.text for b in row] for row in latest.buttons]
        print("BOT_MENU_ROW_SIZES="+",".join(map(lambda x:str(len(x)),rows)))
        if rows!=EXPECTED:
            print("BOT_MENU_CONTRACT_FAIL")
            for row in rows:
                print("ROW="+",".join(row))
            raise RuntimeError("BOT_MENU_LAYOUT_MISMATCH")
        print("USERBOT_REAL_MENU_10_BUTTONS_PASS")
asyncio.run(main())
PY
